descriptionMarkdown: This blueprint is designed to be aligned to a grid that is supposed to overlap with previously placed blueprints. It is meant to be modular and can be force-built on the heavy oil ocean once foundations are unlocked. It is recommended to place the Blueprint and place the first few collectors down before letting your personal robots take over. I made this blueprint to let me clear a resource patch without risk of losing any robots in the process, but you can use it however you want.
title: Advanced Fulgoran Grounding Grid
